name: kisan-setu
description: Kisan Setu - Agricultural Market Linkage Platform

scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n "api,worker,dashboard" -c "cyan,green,magenta" "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:worker" "npm run dev:dashboard"
scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace @kisan-setu/types && npm run build --workspace @kisan-setu/config && npm run build --workspace @kisan-setu/shared
scripts.build:apps: npm run build --workspace @kisan-setu/api && npm run build --workspace @kisan-setu/worker && npm run build --workspace @kisan-setu/dashboard
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:apps
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
